title: Create a slugify module
objective: A new src/slugify.mjs exports slugify(text), turning any text into a URL slug
requirements: src/slugify.mjs exports a named function slugify(text)
every run of characters other than a-z and 0-9 becomes a single '-'
the result has no leading or trailing '-'
an empty string returns an empty string

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given 'Hello, World!', when slugified, then the result is 'hello-world'
Given '--edge--', when slugified, then the result is 'edge'

architectureDecisions: A new module under src/, matching the README's purpose
repositoryFindings: the repository has only a README and a smoke test
